ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - CrackMapExec PowerShell Obfuscation
ruleDefinitions.description: The CrachMapExec pentesting framework implements a PowerShell obfuscation with some static strings detected by this rule.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*join*split.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\(\\ \\$ShellId\\[1\\]\\+\\$ShellId\\[13\\]\\+\\'x\\'\\).*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\(\\ \\$PSHome\\[*\\]\\+\\$PSHOME\\[*\\]\\+.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\(\\ \\$env\\:Public\\[13\\]\\+\\$env\\:Public\\[5\\]\\+\\'x\\'\\).*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\(\\ \\$env\\:ComSpec\\[4\\,*\\,25\\]\\-Join\\'\\'\\).*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\[1\\,3\\]\\+\\'x\\'\\-Join\\'\\'\\).*")))
